hypothesis: A calibrated magnetic vector is invariant under rotation about that field. Preserve this local nullspace in the existing symmetric SO(3) Jacobian with H_gauge = H_symmetric*(I-p*p^T/(p^T*p)), where p is the predicted body field. This retains the symmetric finite residual for shortest-rotation Cayley coordinates and removes its spurious sensitivity along the physical magnetic gauge direction.
scope: Known seed-911 development factorial of projected/nonprojected Jacobians with stationary IMU disabled/enabled, four delay/pressure variants and all GPS scenarios. New gauge cases are generated-C prototypes, not modified Modelica exports. The fresh independent stationary validation does not select or tune this candidate.
